aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized administrative authentication (RADIUS or TACACS) in EdgeOS.
cli: set system login radius-server 192.168.1.50 key secret_key
aaa_enabled.notes: Define remote AAA server parameters to authenticate administrative access.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable insecure Telnet and enable secure SSH remote access.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Enforce secure management access by enabling SSH and deleting/disabling the Telnet service.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Inactivity VTY timeout is hardcoded / not supported natively in standard EdgeOS CLI configuration.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Manual review of client-side keepalive settings (e.g. ClientAliveInterval in sshd_config) is required.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: EdgeOS automatically hashes/encrypts all user administrative passwords at rest.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Ensure default community strings are removed to prevent unauthorized network mapping information leak.

http_server_disabled.notes: The HTTP port service should be deleted to prevent unencrypted administrative connections.

ssh_version_2.notes: Enforces secure protocol version 2 on the SSH daemon.

cli: set system syslog host 192.168.1.100 facility all level err
logging_enabled.notes: Forward device security events and logs to a centralized syslog server.

management_acl.summary: Restrict management services using listen-address bindings.
management_acl.notes: Restricts management daemons to listen only on designated secure internal interfaces/IPs.

cli: set system login banner pre-login "Authorized Access Only."
login_banner.notes: Define a legal notice for display before password prompt.

password_min_length.summary: Password policy complexity enforcement is not supported natively in standalone EdgeOS configuration.
password_min_length.notes: Manual review of account password strength is required.

ntp_configured.notes: Synchronize system clock for accurate log audit trails.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Configure SNMP communities with read-only authorization.
cli: set service snmp community your_community authorization ro
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Configure community strings with read-only access (ro).
